mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_login_histories ( user_id, login_result, login_at, ip_address, user_agent, fail_reason, session_key ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{loginResult}, NOW(), #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{failReason}, #{sessionKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM basic_login_histories ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_login_histories SET logout_at = NOW() WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM basic_login_histories WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND login_result = 'SUCCESS' AND logout_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basic_login_histories WHERE login_result = 'SUCCESS' AND DATE(login_at) = CURRENT_DATE
